bull_bear.body:
- Cumulative technology investment stated as "Invested $35M+ in Technology", framed as the funding behind all three live products.
- Q1 FY27 closing gross cash of INR 1,355 Mn (Q4 FY26: INR 1,420 Mn); the deck attributes the decline to "investments in ONMO+ and repayment of borrowings", after four prior quarters of increases driven by positive operational cash flows, statutory refunds and short-term borrowings.
- Balance sheet at June'26 versus Mar'26: Shareholders' Funds INR 5,855 Mn (6,255), Short Term Borrowings INR 640 Mn (672), Total Assets INR 9,235 Mn (9,809).
- Working-capital intensity remains high on the deck's own trend page: Day's sales outstanding of 121 days in Q1 FY27, against 106 days in Q1 FY26 and a peak of 131 days in Q4 FY26.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)

business.body:
- Product journey is framed as three stages: "MOBILE ENTERTAINMENT & COMMUNICATIONS" (Tones, Videos), "MOBILE GAMING" (ONMO, Challenges Arena, Buzzmo, Gaming Platform) and a "New" "SMART CONSOLE" line (ONMO+ Smart Console).
- "We've focused on one half of the global gaming market. Now we're expanding into the other." The deck describes the industry (not the company) as ~50% revenues from Console & PC Gaming and ~50% from Mobile Gaming, contrasting "500K games" in mobile with "5 Major Players" in Console & Cloud Gaming.
- Distribution reach claim: reaches consumers "through Ecommerce, ISPs, Set-top Box, Retail and Smart TV partners — in addition to 100+ telcos and 4B+ mobile consumers."
- Valuation framing in the investment rationale: "OnMobile trades at a significant discount to gaming industry peers despite now being EBITDA positive," with a re-rating toward sector multiples argued as material upside.
- Deck reports international revenue at 98% of revenue in Q1 FY27 (95%-98% across the eight quarters shown).
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body:
- [Severance] Q1 FY27 PAT is flagged as including "severance cost of INR 141 Mn", shown in the P&L as Exceptional Items of -141; the deck separately attributes an earlier cash draw to "severance pay to international employee exits and pre payment for gaming license cost".
- [Receivables] The P&L comparative column shows an "Impairment of receivables" of INR 468 Mn in Q4 FY26 (nil in Q1 FY27 and Q1 FY26).
- [FX] The MRR chart is USD-denominated with a changing conversion assumption disclosed as "Q3FY25: USD = 83 INR, Q4FY26 & Q1FY27 USD = 94 INR", so USD MRR and INR revenue are not on a constant-rate basis.
- [Channel pipeline] "Advanced discussions with retail partner groups" is listed as a key highlight, i.e. not yet a signed channel.
business.title: Notable from the deck

deepdive.thesis: The deck positions OnMobile as a mobile entertainment and communications business re-platforming into gaming, with the newly launched ONMO+ Smart Console pitched as "THE GROWTH ENGINE" that carries it from mobile gaming into the console/PC half of the market.
